references.text: The firstfruits offering that was to be brought to the Lord, the wave offering of the first sheaves during the Feast of Weeks
Two loaves baked with yeast as a firstfruits offering to the Lord, which were not to be burned on the altar
The first of the firstfruits from the land was to be brought to the house of the Lord
The best of the firstfruits from the land was to be brought to the house of the Lord your God
The best of the oil, the new wine, and the grain, the firstfruits that they give to the Lord
The firstfruits of all the fruit of the ground that are brought to the Lord
The people of Israel brought abundant firstfruits of grain, wine, olive oil, and honey
The people's vow to bring the firstfruits of their land and their trees to the house of the Lord
Honor the Lord with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your produce
The first of all the firstfruits and all the offering gifts shall belong to the priests
Clear contextual link: Numbers 28:26 describes the action on the day of firstfruits that Leviticus 2:12 regulates ritually.
Direct contrast: The verse describes the standard rule for grain offerings from which the firstfruits (Leviticus 2:12) is an exception.
